hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && npx tsx scripts/check-docs-consistency.ts >/dev/null 2>&1 || npx tsx scripts/check-docs-consistency.ts 2>&1 | tail -20; echo 'Docs consistency: the check above only proves that referenced paths still EXIST. It cannot tell you whether the prose is still TRUE. If this edit changed behaviour, re-read (a) the comments in the file you edited, (b) the section of MinusX.md describing this module, and (c) any docs/content/** page describing this behaviour — and update them in this change, not later.'
